notes: Ceiling array microphone (square MXA920-S or round MXA920-R variant) with automatic/steerable coverage. Single RJ45 port (Cat5e or higher, shielded recommended) carries PoE Class 0 power (10.1W max), Dante/AES67 digital audio output, and control simultaneously — there is no separate power connector and no analog audio I/O on this device. Network data-rate (100Mb vs 1Gb) is not stated in Shure's official spec sheet, so no eth-* grade was assigned to the RJ45 port per instructions (omit grade when unstated). Channel count varies by mode: 2 channels (1 output + 1 AEC reference in) with automatic coverage on, or 10 channels (8 independent transmit + 1 automix output + 1 AEC reference in) with automatic coverage off. Not rack-mountable (ceiling-mounted device), so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: Network/PoE (RJ45)
